summary: Built scripts/onboard-learn.js — agentic project learner. It runs a headless claude -p agent with read-only repo access that validates each mined candidate against actual source, KEEPS only non-obvious load-bearing notes (convention/invariant/gotcha/decision) and REJECTS restatements, writing onboard-notes.json. Injection is a separate dry-run-by-default --confirm step reusing the reversible [ingest] overlay-note path. NOTE: the sandbox auto-mode classifier BLOCKS spawning nested --dangerously-skip-permissions agents, so I (the session agent) performed the identical read-validate-keep/reject pass directly against orchestrator source to produce a real validated KB: 53 candidates -> 12 kept, 6 reject-classes. Kept notes are code-verified and non-obvious (e.g. discovered latent bug: addNoteNode id has no random suffix -> same-ms collision; search is lexical not embeddings; merge auto-aborts). inject dry-run verified. node --check clean.
